scripts.build: vite build && npm run docs && node tools/build/copy-docs.mjs && node tools/build/asset-compat.mjs && node tools/build/build-pwa.mjs && node tools/validation/check-asset-build.mjs
scripts.docs: node tools/build/trace-blueprint.mjs && node tools/build/build-sound-library.mjs && node tools/build/build-docs.mjs
scripts.errors:recent: wrangler d1 execute tron-error-reports --remote --command "SELECT id, datetime(received_at/1000, 'unixepoch') AS utc, kind, game, mode, build, substr(user_agent, 1, 60) AS browser, gpu, substr(message, 1, 160) AS message FROM error_reports ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 25"
